name: Brevis
description: Brevis is a ZK coprocessor designed to enhance smart contracts by enabling them to access and compute with full historical on-chain data from various blockchains in a trust-free manner. This application facilitates innovative use cases in the DeFi space, such as data-driven features for user engagement, active liquidity management, and identity verification across multiple chains. Integrating Brevis into a decentralized application (dApp) involves three straightforward steps: accessing historical data through APIs, deploying customized logic using the SDK, and submitting computation results along with ZK proofs back on-chain for verification. Developers can leverage Brevis to create advanced functionalities, exemplified by the Uniswap v4 trading fee discount hook, showcasing the practical applications of this technology.
